parsed.draft_response:
Hi team — thanks for reporting this. We understand that the CSV export button on the invoice page began returning an HTTP 500 error this morning, and that it’s isolated to invoice-page exports (customer exports still work). 

We’ll investigate the invoice-page export failure and work on a fix so you can export invoices again ahead of Friday close. In the meantime, your manual workaround is noted and we’ll do our best to minimize disruption.

To help us pinpoint this faster, could you share (1) the approximate time the issue started, and (2) an example invoice page URL (or invoice ID) where the export fails, plus the timestamp of the 500 response if you have it? If you see any error details in the browser/network log, that would also be helpful.
